summary: Add inactive canonical execution identity and pure idempotency decisions in fractal-jobs.

replay.detail: No projections or persistent receipts; those belong to unit 4.

schema.detail: Pure unused types only; no database schema changes.

rules.detail: No authority, configuration defaults or admission changes. Gate-slot remains the admission path.

compatibility.detail: No runtime consumer. Versioned canonical bytes bind exact source, complete environment, argv, source-relative cwd and resources; matching requester/key digests reuse a job, changed digests are refused. Typed command validation rejects empty argv or an empty executable, permitting empty later arguments.

downtime.detail: No runtime wiring or host activation.

recovery.detail: Removing these inactive contracts does not change runtime behavior.
